summary: The narrator confronts a DHS agent who held her in a hospital, then leaves the room at gunpoint after she yields. Having lost her shirt, she slips out of the building, steals a car, and drives into the desert outside Los Angeles. There she stops, nursing a broken thumb and a burned left hand, and prepares to remove the tracker from her side with a pocket multitool blade.
one_line: A wounded narrator escapes a DHS hospital at gunpoint, steals a car, and flees into the Southern California desert to dig out a tracker.
key_facts: The narrator tells the DHS agent that being airlifted to the nearest hospital and not taken somewhere secure afterward means she is being fooled into thinking she is getting the best of the deal.
The agent insists "It's not a trick" and says "I've been straightforward with you."
The narrator says the agent's straightforwardness was so she would know she couldn't run off and sell the proof after finding Halliday, and so she would know the agent had a leash on her.
The narrator threatens the agent: "Get out of my way. Or so help me, I will shoot you."
The narrator leaves the room keeping the agent's own gun trained on her and is not stopped.
The narrator's shirt is missing because a surgeon probably cut it off, so she zipped up her jacket instead.
The narrator changed clothes in a stairwell and walked out of the hospital with no other security present.
The narrator's DHS-returned pockets were untouched, and she stole the first car she came to.
She drove out past the outskirts of LA into the desert, where civilization drained down to gas stations and dust.
Her broken thumb was popped back into place on her way out of the hospital but still sends spasms up her right arm.
The burn on her left hand, under the hospital's bandage, has started to prickle again.
She dropped her main knife at the diner when they took her, but she has a pocket multitool with a blade.
Her side wound aches, and she feels the tracker is poisoning her and making her theirs.
She leans back and squeezes her eyes shut, telling herself she has to be able to do this.

entities.name: Halliday
